topic: What does ごしたい mean?
title_jp: {方言|ほうげん}って{難|むずか}しい
context: Wednesday 25 November, a quiet afternoon at ゲストハウス{風|かぜ}: アルちゃん tells {健太|けんた} he misunderstood {田中|たなか}さん's Nagano dialect this morning. {健太|けんた} explains why Japanese changes from region to region, and why he doesn't use Kansai-ben with guests.
scene: Quiet Wednesday at reception. This morning {田中|たなか}さん said something you didn't understand at all, and you answered the wrong thing.

phrases.jp: {地域|ちいき|region, area|3}によって、{言葉|ことば}や{習慣|しゅうかん|custom, habit|3}が{違います|ちがいます}。
phrases.en: Language and customs differ from region to region.
phrases.note: 〜によって{違|ちが}う = it varies by… The most common use of によって.

phrases.jp: {人|ひと}によって、{好み|このみ|taste, liking|3}は{違う|ちがう}からね。
phrases.en: Everyone's taste is different, after all.
phrases.note: Ending with 〜からね gives a reason softly, like 'after all'.

phrases.jp: {遅れた|おくれた}のは、{雪|ゆき}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{止まった|とまった}からです。
phrases.en: The reason I was late is that the train stopped because of the snow.
phrases.note: 〜のは〜からです puts the reason last: a clear, polite explanation.

phrases.jp: {方言|ほうげん|dialect|3}が{分からなくて|わからなくて}、{勘違い|かんちがい|misunderstanding|3}しちゃった。
phrases.en: I didn't understand the dialect, so I got it wrong.
phrases.note: 〜なくて gives the cause of what happened next. {勘違|かんちが}いする = to get the wrong idea.

phrases.jp: {ごしたい||(Nagano dialect) tired, worn out|1}{ずら||(Nagano dialect) = でしょう, right?|1}。
phrases.note: Standard: {疲|つか}れたでしょう. Older people in Nagano say it; don't copy it at work.

dialogue_setting: ゲストハウス{風|かぜ}, reception desk, a quiet Wednesday afternoon with no check-ins yet.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {健太|けんた}、{今朝|けさ}{田中|たなか}さんに「{ごしたい||(Nagano dialect) tired, worn out|1}{ずら||(Nagano dialect) = でしょう, right?|1}」って{言われて|いわれて}、「{何|なに}がしたいの？」って{聞いちゃった|きいちゃった}。
dialogue.en: {健太|けんた}, this morning {田中|たなか}さん said 'ごしたいずら' to me, and I asked 'What do you want to do?'

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: ｗｗそれ{勘違い|かんちがい|misunderstanding|3}や。「ごしたい」は{長野|ながの}の{方言|ほうげん|dialect|3}で、「{疲れた|つかれた}」って{意味|いみ|meaning|4}やで。
dialogue.en: Haha, you got the wrong idea. 'ごしたい' is Nagano dialect and means 'tired'.
dialogue.note: や = だ, やで = だよ (Kansai).

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {日本|にほん}って、{地域|ちいき|region, area|3}によってそんなに{言葉|ことば}が{違う|ちがう}の？なんで？
dialogue.en: Does Japanese really change that much depending on the region? Why?

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: {昔|むかし|long ago, in the old days|4}は{山|やま}の{向こう側|むこうがわ|the other side|3}と、あんまり{行き来|いきき|coming and going|2}がなかったからや。それで{言葉|ことば}が{ばらばら||all different, scattered|3}に{変わった|かわった}んやて。
dialogue.en: Because long ago people didn't go back and forth much with the other side of the mountains. So the words changed in different ways, they say.
dialogue.note: からや = からだ, んやて = んだって (they say).

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: じゃあ、{健太|けんた}が{仕事|しごと}で{関西弁|かんさいべん|Kansai dialect|3}を{使わない|つかわない}のは、なんで？
dialogue.en: So why don't you use Kansai-ben at work?

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: お{客|きゃく}さんに{通じへん|つうじへん|(Kansai) not get across = つうじない|3}こともあるし、{きつく||harsh, sharp|3}{聞こえる|きこえる|to sound (like)|4}{人|ひと}もおるからな。
dialogue.en: Because sometimes guests don't understand it, and to some people it sounds harsh.
dialogue.note: {通|つう}じへん = {通|つう}じない, おる = いる (Kansai).

listening.intro: On your way home, an announcement on the platform at {鷹ノ原駅|たかのはらえき}.
listening.title: {鷹ノ原駅|たかのはらえき}のお{知らせ|しらせ}
listening.place: {鷹ノ原駅|たかのはらえき}, platform

lines.jp: お{知らせ|しらせ}します。{大雪|おおゆき|heavy snow|3}によって、{長野|ながの}{行き|いき}の{電車|でんしゃ}は{約|やく}15{分|ふん}{遅れて|おくれて}おります。
lines.en: An announcement. Because of heavy snow, the train for {長野|ながの} is running about 15 minutes late.

lines.jp: お{急ぎ|いそぎ}のところ、ご{迷惑|めいわく|trouble, inconvenience|3}をおかけして{申し訳|もうしわけ}ございません。
lines.en: We apologise for the inconvenience when you are in a hurry.

listening.question: {電車|でんしゃ}はどうして{遅|おく}れていますか。
options: {雪|ゆき}がたくさん{降|ふ}ったから
{鹿|しか}が{線路|せんろ}に{入|はい}ったから
listening.explain: {大雪|おおゆき}によって = because of heavy snow. In announcements によって (or により) gives a formal cause.

grammar.form: depends on: noun + によって ({地域|ちいき}によって, {人|ひと}によって) · cause: noun + によって ({大雪|おおゆき}によって, {事故|じこ}によって) · passive 'by': noun + によって ({隼人|はやと}によって{守られた|まもられた})
grammar.explanation: Most often 'it differs depending on X': {地域|ちいき}によって{違|ちが}う. It also gives a formal cause (news, announcements) and the doer of a passive in written style. Don't mix it up with によると (according to), which names where information came from.

examples.jp: {店|みせ}によって、{値段|ねだん}がかなり{違います|ちがいます}。
examples.en: Prices vary quite a lot from shop to shop.

examples.jp: {大雪|おおゆき|heavy snow|3}によって、{電車|でんしゃ}が{止まりました|とまりました}。
examples.en: The trains stopped because of heavy snow.

quiz.question: {曜日|ようび}＿＿、お{客|きゃく}さんの{数|かず}が{違います|ちがいます}。
quiz.en: The number of guests differs depending on the day of the week.
quiz.explain: Something changes depending on X → によって. によると = according to, について = about, にとって = for (someone).

quiz_more.question: {台風|たいふう|typhoon|3}＿＿、{試合|しあい}が{中止|ちゅうし|cancellation|3}になりました。
quiz_more.en: The match was cancelled because of the typhoon.
quiz_more.explain: A formal cause → によって. のおかげで is only for good results.

quiz_more.question: {天気予報|てんきよほう|weather forecast|3}＿＿、{明日|あした}も{雪|ゆき}だそうです。
quiz_more.en: According to the forecast, it'll snow tomorrow too.
quiz_more.explain: Here the forecast is a source of information + そうです, so によると, not によって.

kanji.meaning: Shinshū, the old name for Nagano
kanji.where: Printed on the {信州弁|しんしゅうべん} hand towels sold at reception, under a list of dialect words.
kanji.breakdown: {信州|しんしゅう}: 信 trust + 州 province → short for {信濃国|しなののくに}, the old province that is now Nagano.
kanji.related: {信州|しんしゅう}そば = Nagano soba; {信州弁|しんしゅうべん} = Nagano dialect.

tip.title: Every region has its 〜{弁|べん}
tip.body: Dialects are named with {弁|べん}: {関西弁|かんさいべん}, {信州弁|しんしゅうべん}, {博多弁|はかたべん}. Many people speak standard Japanese ({標準語|ひょうじゅんご}) at work and switch back with family, so the same person can sound like two people. Say ずら yourself and older locals will laugh and love it.

challenge.prompt: {健太|けんた} asks: 「スペインにも{方言|ほうげん|dialect|3}ってあるん？」 Tell him yes, and that the language differs a lot depending on the region.
challenge.model_answer: うん、{地域|ちいき|region, area|3}によって{言葉|ことば}がかなり{違う|ちがう}よ。
challenge.explanation: {地域|ちいき}によって sets up what the difference depends on, and the sentence ends with {違|ちが}う, the verb によって usually goes with. Plain form + よ fits a coworker your age.
challenge.hint: {地域|ちいき}によって · 〜{違|ちが}う

vocab.note: {勘違|かんちが}いする = to get it wrong in your head. Softer than {間違|まちが}い.
{方|ほう} direction, region + {言|げん} words. A specific one is 〜{弁|べん}.
どういう{意味|いみ}？ = what do you mean? 〜って{意味|いみ} = it means…
Common in news and notices: {地域|ちいき}の{人|ひと} = local people.
{向|む}こう over there + {側|がわ} side. {道|みち}の{向|む}こう{側|がわ} = across the road.
{昔|むかし}{昔|むかし}… = once upon a time.
{日本語|にほんご}が{通|つう}じた！ = they understood my Japanese! Also: a road leads somewhere.
{習|しゅう} learn + {慣|かん} get used to. {日本|にほん}の{習慣|しゅうかん} = Japanese customs.
From {好|この}む (to like). {好|この}みのタイプ = your type.

kanji_study.parts: ⻌ road radical + 韋 (two feet walking in opposite directions) → two people going different ways on the road: differ.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 偉 (great): 偉 has 亻 person on the left, 違 has the ⻌ road along the bottom.

kanji_study.parts: 亻 person + 則 rule → a person standing beside you, keeping to the rule: side.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 測 (measure): 測 has 氵 water on the left, 側 has 亻 person.
